chunks: So that he who disbelieves will bear the consequence of his unbelief; and he who does the right will straighten out the way for himself,
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'fala nufusihim yamhadun' in Surah Ar-Rum?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle of *al-Insaf* (divine fairness), emphasizing that the consequences of one's actions are intrinsic to the individual rather than imposed externally. It highlights the dual trajectory of the soul: the disbeliever bears the weight of their own rejection, while the righteous actively construct their spiritual foundation for the afterlife. This reinforces the concept of *Amal* (action) as the decisive factor in determining one's eternal fate.
